purpose: One stable reporting frame; the substance of the self-assessment remains evidence-grounded and open.

sections.title: Điều gì thật sự thay đổi
Tôi muốn học hoặc kiểm chứng gì tiếp
Notebook của tôi đang giữ gì
Tôi tự đánh giá hôm nay thế nào

rules: Template defines sections only; it does not force PASS/FAIL, score, grade or a fixed conclusion.
Do not impose arbitrary character truncation on report content.
The agent may say nothing meaningful changed or that it has no new learning request.
Keep observation, inference, uncertainty and notebook attention distinguishable.
Notebook may guide attention but is not evidence and cannot increase authority.
A formal learning request exists only when requested_learning is present; curiosity is separate.
Confidence alone is not progress; repetition alone is not independent corroboration.
Self-assessment cannot certify itself as correct; independent evidence review remains external.
